_comment: PSG Chip column (scraper/psg.py). 'engines': the PSG an MSX-Engine / MSX-SYSTEM integrates, from its msx.org page — 'psg' is the name the cell shows ("YM2149 in S3527"), null when the engine has no sound chip; 'note' goes in the cell tooltip. An engine not listed here (X3527, T9763: no page) keeps the chip the model page names. 'chips': every spelling of a PSG chip in msx.org Audio texts (regex, case-insensitive) → the name the cell shows. Add entries here — no code change needed.

S3527.note: Yamaha S3527 (MSX-SYSTEM): a Yamaha YM2149 PSG, compatible with a General Instrument AY-3-8910

S1985.note: Yamaha S1985 (MSX-SYSTEMII): a Yamaha YM2149 PSG, compatible with a General Instrument AY-3-8910

T7937.note: Toshiba T7937 (MSX-ENGINE): PSG Toshiba T7766A (AY-3-8910 compatible)

T7937A.note: Toshiba T7937A (MSX-ENGINE): PSG Toshiba T7766A (AY-3-8910 compatible)

T9769.note: Toshiba T9769 (MSX-ENGINE): PSG Toshiba T7766A (AY-3-8910 compatible)

T7775.note: Toshiba T7775 (MSX-ENGINE): does not include the sound chip
